map.📚 深度解析：人体存在传感器选型与覆盖面积估算: 📚 Deep Dive: Human-Presence Sensor Selection & Coverage Estimate
map.安防/照明选型：按检测距离、安装高度、温度与检测方式推荐传感器: Security / lighting selection: recommend a sensor by detection distance, mounting height, temperature and method
map.覆盖估算：按安装高度与距离算圆锥覆盖面积: Coverage estimate: compute conical coverage area from mounting height and distance
map.规格校核：判定参数是否超出传感器最大检测距离: Spec check: judge whether parameters exceed the sensor's max detection distance
map.覆盖面积=π×安装高度×tan(30°)×检测距离；各方式最大检测距离：红外PI: Coverage area = π × mounting height × tan(30°) × detection distance; max distances: IR PIR 8 m, microwave 12 m, ultrasonic 5 m, dual-tech 10 m; actual distance ≤ max and (for PIR) temperature within −20~50℃ to qualify.
map.红外PIR、距离5m、高度2.5m、温度25℃：覆盖=π×2.5×tan30°×: IR PIR, distance 5 m, height 2.5 m, 25℃: coverage = π×2.5×tan30°×5≈22.7 m², max distance 8 m (5≤8 ✓), temperature OK → meets spec. Ultrasonic, distance 6 m: max 5 m (6>5) → exceeds spec, change model or reduce distance.
map.覆盖面积为什么用 tan30°？: Why use tan30° for coverage area?
map.假设传感器半张角约30°，地面覆盖半径为 高度×tan30°，面积按圆近似；实际: Assume a sensor half-angle of about 30°, so ground radius = height × tan30°, area approximated as a circle; actual FOV varies by model, follow the datasheet.
map.PIR 和微波怎么选？: How to choose PIR vs microwave?
map.PIR 对移动人体敏感、怕热源/阳光直射；微波可隔墙、灵敏度高但易误报；双鉴兼顾: PIR is sensitive to moving bodies but dislikes heat sources/direct sun; microwave penetrates walls and is sensitive but prone to false alarms; dual-tech balances both. If distance exceeds range, use a longer-range model or lower the mount.
map.不同检测方式适用场景不同，红外适合移动检测，微波适合微动检测: Different methods suit different scenes: IR for motion, microwave for micro-motion
map.安装高度影响检测覆盖范围，一般2~3米为宜: Mounting height affects coverage; generally 2–3 m is suitable
map.红外传感器受环境温度影响，高温环境灵敏度下降: IR sensors are affected by ambient temperature; sensitivity drops in high heat
